1461714.ov_hu: Az Emmy- és Golden Globe-díjas színésznő, Mariska Hargitay mesél édesanyjáról, Jayne Mansfieldről és örökségéről, közel hatvan évvel halála után.
1461714.ov_en: Through deeply personal interviews with her siblings and an examination of the photographs, letters, and belongings left behind, Mariska assembles a new portrait of her mother Jayne Mansfield, an extraordinary and complex woman.

1386514.ov_de: Was ist der Unterschied zwischen Donald Trump und Jesus? Comedy-Star Bill Maher nimmt in seinem bereits 13. Stand-up-Auftritt für HBO Heuchler und Extremisten aller politischen Lager aufs Korn.
1386514.ov_hu: Tizenharmadik HBO-műsorában Bill Maher humorista az amerikai élet, politika és kultúra számos képmutató jelenségére hívja fel a figyelmet.
1386514.ov_en: With his signature sardonic wit and unfiltered approach, acclaimed comedian Bill Maher offers up his scathing commentary on the hypocrisies of both conservative and liberal politics, as well as trends in modern parenting, sex and dating, and religion.

768614.ov_de: Als Billie erfährt, dass ihre entfremdeten Eltern sich in Lebensgefahr befinden und dringend Geld benötigen, setzt sie alles auf eine Karte und überfällt eine Bank. Der Überfall läuft jedoch alles andere als glatt, weswegen sie die hochschwangere Jugendliche Franny als Geisel nimmt. Gemeinsam fliehen die beiden nun quer durch die USA und lernen sich dabei besser kennen.
768614.ov_hu: Amikor Billie megtudja, hogy elhidegült szülei élete veszélyben van, megpróbál segíteni nekik azzal, hogy kirabol egy bankot. A balul sikerült rablási kísérlet során túszul ejt egy Franny nevű lányt, aki egy elbűvölően impulzív, terhes tinédzsernek bizonyul, akinek nincs mit vesztenie. Billie és Franny együtt indulnak el egy üldözésbe az amerikai tájakon, összecsapnak és küzdenek a közös nevezőért, remélve, hogy egy jobb jövő vár rájuk.
768614.ov_en: When Billie learns that her estranged parents' lives are at risk, she tries to help them by robbing a bank. In her botched robbery attempt, she takes a hostage named Franny, who turns out to be a charmingly impulsive pregnant teenager with nothing left to lose. Together, Billie and Franny embark on a chase through scenic American landscapes, clashing and struggling for common ground in hopes for a brighter future.

281514.ov_en: Giorgio, a young mining engineer, moved to work in Africa. His wife does not want to follow him and he suspects a betrayal. In the cast also Rocky Roberts singing two songs.

278914.ov_en: A girl is drafted due to a misunderstanding and this gives her the occasion to check on her boy-friend, whom she believes to be a womanizer.

33414.ov_en: Morten Arnfred's warm comedy Lykkevej (Move Me) begins with Sara (Birthe Neumann) being left by her husband of a quarter century. Sara gets a job and moves into a new home on a street populated by eccentrics. Neighbor Robert (Jesper Lohmann) showers in his backyard, has been in mourning since his wife's death, and annoys his neighbors by keeping junk on his front yard. Sara and Robert tentatively strike up a relationship, while a couple on the street, Sus and Bo (Ditte Grbl and Asger Reher), have their own marriage issues to deal with. Move Me was screened at the Gothenburg Film Festival.

336414.ov_en: A young worker enjoying an affair with an upper class beauty, Adelaida, is drafted by the Spanish Army to fight in the Cuban War of Independence. After Adelaida receives an unusual announcement regarding her lover's death in combat, she refuses to believe the loss of her lover. Her class-conscious family, led by her jealous sister Maria, believes that Adelaida has lost her mind and places Adelaida in an insane asylum. However, Adelaida continues to to live according to her beliefs of passion and freedom. Fellow "inmates" tell her about the wood-nymphs which inhabit the adjacent forest. Adelaida is convinced these nymphs will lead her to her lover and to happiness.

134414.ov_en: In war-torn 11th century Spain, Ruy de Vivar, just a boy, dreams of becoming an invincible warrior.

1072814.ov_en: After reconnecting with her biological family, a young woman travels to Iran, where she must navigate a world of unfamiliar customs and traditions.

650614.ov_hu: A mexikói rarámuri népcsoportba tartozó Lorena Ramírez pásztorként él – de olykor felhúzza a futócipőjét, hogy ultramaratonokon induljon.
650614.ov_en: A young woman of the Tarahumara, well-known for their extraordinary long distance running abilities, wins ultramarathons seemingly out of nowhere despite running in sandals.

525814.ov_en: Comedians and writers Steve Martin and Martin Short perform a live comedy set with music by The Steep Canyon Rangers and jazz pianist, Jeff Babko, at the Peace Center in Greenville, South Carolina.

529414.ov_en: Mexican stand-up comedian Franco Escamilla draws his jokes from real-life experiences -- and he's willing to do anything for new material. He's not afraid to make generalizations about how men bathe. But he is scared to talk to strangers. Especially at funerals.

686514.ov_en: How could Gulosten, who was a major criminal during prohibition, and a resistance fighter during WW2, get away with the murder of two Germans in peacetime Norway? And what part did his friend, king Haakon of Norway, play in this?

1740614.ov_en: Follows an investigation into a double murder in 1999, with unexpected characters roped into the case as they search for justice amid intrigue and secrets.

985314.ov_en: Pete Davidson jokes about rumors, free plane rides and his very weird year as he invites his friends onstage for a night of stand-up comedy and music.

639414.ov_hu: Egy kiábrándult nagyvárosi feleség és újonnan a városba érkezett unokatestvére igyekszik megtalálni a saját útját a szabadsághoz a titkok és álmok tengerében.
639414.ov_en: A disillusioned Delhi wife (Dolly), and her new-in-town cousin (Kitty), navigate damning secrets, dreams and their thorny dynamic on their respective roads to freedom.

1137914.ov_en: Shaurya aka Show, a self-centered & attention seeking youngster moves from Rajavaram to Vizag, and falls for a brilliant medico student Sahaja at Vizag. While attempting to convince Sahaja’s father, Show faces an unique problem and new revelations about his beloved hometown.

1012514.ov_en: Ocean Therapy is the story of an unknown hero, Bruno, surfer, skipper bound for living on the ocean, navigating and discovery. Bruno’s dream falls appart when, at 24 years old, he is victim of an accident and looses the use of his legs. After a deep period of depression and two suicide attempts, Bruno will reconnect with life through his passion for the Ocean. Ocean Therapy is the authentic story of a man that lives for his passions.

1153214.ov_de: Der Geheimpolizist Budny bekommt im kommunistischen Polen den Auftrag, einen Bischof zu überwachen – einen gewissen Karol Wojtyla, der später zu Papst Johannes Paul II. werden soll. Über 20 Jahre verfolgt Budny jeden Schritt und Tritt des Geistlichen, wird dabei immer obsessiver, sieht sich immer mehr als Teil von Wojtylas Leben. Eine besondere Beziehung entwickelt sich zwischen beiden – auch wenn der eine gar nicht weiß, dass der andere existiert.
1153214.ov_en: Budny, a secret service officer, secretly surveils Bishop Karol Wojtyla for 20 years. An unreciprocated bond forms between Budny and the unaware Wojtyla, leading to an obsessive, pathological relationship from Budny's perspective.

1061114.ov_en: In a freewheeling stand-up performance for a packed Montreal arena, the comedian shares stories about paintball mishaps, McDonald’s misdeeds and more.

208614.ov_hu: Vic DeSalvo mindig is arról álmodott, hogy jól menő televíziós producer lesz belőle. De hogyan lehet betörni a szakmába mindenfajta tapasztalat nélkül? Vic helyzetét csak súlyosbítja, hogy karrierjét egyetlen hónap leforgása alatt kell beindítania, különben mehet vissza teherautósofőrnek New Jerseybe. Ám egyszerre hatalmas ötlete támad. Egy újonnan szerzett barátjával, aki egy médiakutató cég statisztikusa, Vic olyan műsort talál ki, ami szinte azonnal a legjobb producerek közé emeli. Felemelkedésével azonban nem csak barátokat, hanem esküdt ellenségeket is szerez.
208614.ov_en: A New Jersey trucker creates a hit TV show with help from his girlfriend in the ratings business.

135714.ov_en: For Robbing the Dead is a story of compassion - compassion toward those who may seem the least deserving of Christian love. It follows the story of Henry Heath, a law officer in 1862 Salt Lake City. Heath finds himself responsible for the well-being of a prisoner whom he despises - an impoverished French immigrant named Jean Baptiste who is convicted of robbing the graves of the recently deceased. Baptiste is exiled to Antelope Island in the Great Salt Lake. With no one willing to look after this man, Henry Heath becomes Baptiste's sole defense against the hostile isolation of Antelope Island and the contempt of an entire community. Through his somewhat reluctant service, Heath's heart softens and his own sorrows find relief.
